2993e3a7: What is the name of the dark parallel dimension?
The Upside Down is a dark parallel dimension, a twisted copy of Hawkins overrun by creatures.

The Demogorgon is the first monster, a faceless humanoid creature that stalks the people of Hawkins by way of the Upside Down.
21321f35: In which fictional Indiana town is the series set?
Hawkins is the fictional small town in Indiana, a typical picture of 1980s America with horrors hiding beneath it.
d40c6a32: Who is the main local police chief at the start of the series?
Jim Hopper is Hawkins's police chief, a man broken by the death of his daughter Sara who becomes Eleven's surrogate father.

Dungeons & Dragons: the kids use its creatures (Demogorgon, Mind Flayer) to name the entities of the Upside Down.

87e6ae3e: Who is Eleven's “Papa” at the laboratory?
Dr. Martin Brenner runs the experiments on Eleven. He makes her call him “Papa” and has conditioned her since childhood.

The Mind Flayer, named after a Dungeons & Dragons monster, is the giant entity that takes possession of Will in season 2.
e1e806fd: What is the name of the popular high schooler who becomes an unexpected hero?
Steve Harrington goes from popular jerk to true hero and protector of the kids. His redemption arc is one of the most beloved.
5d8ed701: What is the name of the season 3 mall that hides a Soviet base?
Starcourt Mall hides a Soviet base underneath, trying to reopen the gate to the Upside Down.
b7909b08: Who is Billy Hargrove and what is his role?
Max's stepbrother, possessed by the Mind Flayer
Billy is Max's stepbrother. Possessed by the Mind Flayer in season 3, he ends up sacrificing himself to save Eleven.
84bafeb9: What are the dog-like creatures from the Upside Down that appear in season 2 called?
Demodogs are creatures from the Upside Down. Dustin takes in a tiny one he names Dart.

Vecna, real name Henry Creel, is Brenner's very first test subject. He massacred the other children at the laboratory.

Should I Stay or Should I Go
Kate Bush's “Running Up That Hill” connects Max to her happy memories, keeping Vecna from killing her in season 4.
e89425c2: What is Vecna's real name before his transformation?
Henry Creel is Vecna's real name. Born with natural powers, he killed his mother and sister and was taken in by Brenner as subject 001.

His Soviet captors call Hopper “the American”: he is held prisoner in Russia after the battle of Starcourt Mall.

Joyce realizes that Will can control the lights from the Upside Down: she paints an alphabet on the wall and communicates through blinking bulbs.
5f2e90d1: Who plays Eleven in the series?
Millie Bobby Brown plays Eleven. Nominated for an Emmy at 13, she became a worldwide star.

Hawkins National Laboratory officially belongs to the Department of Energy, a bureaucratic cover for experiments linked to the MKUltra program.
30231fb5: In which main year is season 1 set?
Season 1 takes place in November 1983 in Hawkins, Indiana, allowing references to early-80s films, music and technology.
9fe41a0d: What is the name of the first creature Dustin tames in season 2?
Dart is the Demodog Dustin adopts and feeds with 3 Musketeers bars. Dart grows into a full Upside Down creature.

e9f151d1: Which D&D monster inspires the name of the great entity of the Upside Down?

Kamchatka is the Soviet base where the Soviets try to reproduce the American experiments to open their own gate to the Upside Down.

Murray Bauman is the paranoid journalist who unravels conspiracies. He is behind several key revelations about the laboratory.

f33a9be4: David Harbour plays Jim Hopper, one of the fans' favorite characters.
38aaf3e6: What is the first name of Joyce's son who disappears in episode 1?
Will Byers vanishes into the Upside Down in the first episode of season 1, and his disappearance sets off the whole plot.
1cfe1109: Who is the kindly scientist who replaces Brenner in season 2?
Sam Owens is the laboratory's kindly director in season 2. He helps Hopper legally adopt Eleven.
15fb960a: What is the name of Jonathan's girlfriend in the early seasons?
Nancy Wheeler is Mike's sister. She becomes Jonathan's girlfriend after breaking up with Steve Harrington.
8952bcce: Dacre Montgomery plays Billy Hargrove in seasons 2 and 3, giving depth to a character first presented as a simple antagonist.

Lucas plays for the Hawkins Tigers in season 4, his attempt to fit in socially.

74667fb3: What is the name of Dustin's girlfriend he met at camp?
Suzie is the girlfriend Dustin met at science camp. Real despite his friends' doubts, she knows Planck's constant by heart.

He shows them visions of their worst traumas
Vecna traps his victims in a vision of their worst traumas, plunging them into a trance that leaves them at his mercy.
3fcd845b: Which actor plays Dr. Martin Brenner in the series?
Matthew Modine plays Dr. Brenner, an ambiguous character who claims to love Eleven while subjecting her to traumatic experiments.

Bob Newby (Sean Astin), Joyce's boyfriend in season 2, helps the group escape the laboratory and dies a hero.

Will disappears on the evening of November 6, 1983, biking home after a game of Dungeons & Dragons.
